elements_not_encoded.text: If pain severe, give morphine 5-10mg IM, repeat 4-6 hourly until patient referred, or give diluted morphine1 3-10mg slow IV: start with 3mL IV over 3 minutes. I

judgment_calls.decision: 'Anal symptoms' = (clinical_finding Anal finding); descendants (Anal pain, Pruritus ani, Anal fissure, Ulcer of anus, Anal warts) match. Perianal lump, rectal bleeding, mucus, tenesmus and worms in stool are NOT descendants, so they need some anal finding recorded to trigger the task.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Anal pain (too narrow); Disorder of anus (excludes findings).

judgment_calls.decision: Perianal lump AND Anal pain (Severe) in the priority rule.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Perianal lump alone (over-fires); Severe pain (finding) unsited.

judgment_calls.decision: Does not defecate, ANDed with the Anal finding trigger for 'because of anal symptoms'.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Difficulty in ability to defecate (weaker than 'unable').

judgment_calls.decision: 'Treat for sexually transmitted proctitis' encoded as probable Infective proctitis, not conditioned on anal sex (separate sentence on the page).
judgment_calls.alternatives: possible level; requiring anal sex history.

judgment_calls.decision: Worms in stool AND Pruritus ani qualified Night time -> probable Enterobiasis. 'Thin and white' and the 'No' branch (not flat/segmented) are not representable.
Not encoded (no SNOMED finding for a flat segmented worm).
judgment_calls.alternatives: probable Cestode infection on Worms in stool alone (would fire for every worm).
